name: Surface Mining
description: Basic extraction techniques allow workers to exploit iron, stone, and gold deposits on the surface. Unlocks the Mine building.

name: Organized Foresting
description: Systematic logging and replanting turns forests into a reliable source of timber income. Unlocks the Forestry building.

name: Record Keeping
description: Scribes and ledgers allow rulers to extract more research value from their capitals, generating an additional research point per capital each turn.

name: Agricultural Methods
description: Improved farming techniques and crop management boost yields from farms and gardens by 15%.

name: Library Studies
description: Investment in scholarly infrastructure unlocks the construction of Libraries, which generate research points each turn.

name: Crop Rotation
description: Rotating crops between seasons dramatically increases agricultural output. Unlocks a Farm building.

name: Banking System
description: Formal banking institutions enable capital accumulation at scale, trimming administrative overhead and reducing total upkeep by 5%.

name: Supply Logistics
description: Guild-run supply chains extend how far an army can range from a supply source before distance penalties kick in, adding 2 tiles of penalty-free supply range.

name: Trade Efficiency
description: Streamlined workshops and standardized measures boost all goods production by 15%.

name: Advanced Taxation
description: Sophisticated tax collectors extract a flat 10 gold from every owned province each turn.

name: Zoning Laws
description: Denser building codes on flat, arable land raise the construction cap on Plains provinces by 1.

name: Mountain Engineering
description: Terracing and retaining-wall techniques let engineers pack one more building into a Mountain province.

name: Trade Monopoly
description: Total dominance of regional trade networks. All income is boosted by 10%.

name: Grand Treasury
description: A central treasury consolidates the nation's immense wealth, boosting all income by a further 15%.

name: Sword Training
description: Train your soldiers in advanced swordsmanship, increasing attacking army power by 15% and unlocking the Infantry troop type.

name: Archery Doctrine
description: Organized training in ranged warfare. Unlocks Archers for recruitment into armies.

name: Pike Formations
description: Disciplined pike squares provide an unbreakable defensive line. Unlocks Pikemen for recruitment.

name: Seafaring
description: Experienced crews can keep an army at sea longer before it is lost, adding 4 turns to the water residency limit.

name: Improved Logistics
description: Unlocks road construction, letting armies move further per turn along a friendly road network.

name: Best Logistics
description: Higher-grade road surfaces extend the maximum road-move range by 1 hop.

name: Heavy Cavalry
description: Mastery of mounted warfare and armoured horsemanship. Unlocks Knights for recruitment (requires an Armory).

name: Veteran Officers
description: Experienced commanders improve offensive coordination across all unit types, granting an additional 10% attack power.

name: Shield Wall Doctrine
description: Drilled defensive formations hold the line better, granting 15% additional defense power.

name: Mandatory Conscription
description: Wider mobilization laws let every Barracks and Capital muster 20 extra troops into the draft pool each turn.

name: Elite Discipline
description: Rigorous drilling further hardens defensive lines, granting a further 10% defense power.

name: Army Logistics
description: Streamlined supply chains and quartermaster corps reduce total army upkeep by 20%.

name: Grand Strategy
description: Mastery of large-scale campaign doctrine. A further 10% to both attack and defense power across all armies.

name: Merchant Guild Charter
description: A formal charter establishes the Merchant Guild as the ruling class. Streamlined economic administration reduces all upkeep by 15%. Commits your nation to the Merchant Guild path.

name: Trade House
description: Buy! Sell! Buy! Sell! Unlocks the Trade House building.

name: Mercenary Corps
description: Formal contracts with sellsword companies. Unlocks the Mercenary unit type, hired directly with money and bypassing the draft pool entirely.

name: Spice Trade
description: Guild captains open trade routes for rare spices hauled in off the water. Unlocks the Spice Wharf building, which turns Fish into Spices — the guild class's unique prestige good. Requires a Port.

name: Banking Cartel
description: A cartel of guild bankers streamlines financing for every workshop in the realm, boosting goods production by 15%.

name: Smuggling Routes
description: Back-channel supply routes known only to the guild extend penalty-free supply range by 1 tile.

name: Monopoly Charter
description: A royal charter grants the guild exclusive trading rights across the realm, boosting all income by 10%.

name: Free Company
description: The guild's ultimate mercenary contract. Unlocks the Free Company unit type, hired with money and the guild's own Spices — but permanently fed on Warhorses, NOBLE's prestige good. Requires a Spice Wharf.

name: Holy Order
description: A devoted way for your God, heretics will burn, locks you to the path of God! Unlocks piety income from Temples and Cathedrals.

name: Temple Consecration
description: Consecrated ground for prayer and worship. Unlocks the Temple building.

name: Warriors of God
description: True followers of faith. Unlocks the Paladin unit type, recruited and maintained on piety instead of money. Requires a Temple.

name: Cathedral
description: A grand palace of God, drawing pilgrims and their donations. Unlocks the Cathedral building, which gives more piety and protection.

name: Relic Veneration
description: Sanctified bones and shrouds, bought with gold and enshrined for veneration. Unlocks the Reliquary building, which turns Gold into Relics — the holy class's unique prestige good. Requires a Temple.

name: Inquisition
description: Rooting out heresy within the ranks sharpens religious zeal, granting a further 10% attack power.

name: Mandatory Tithe
description: A compulsory tithe from every parish under the Cathedral's reach boosts all income by 10%.

name: Templar Order
description: Sworn knight-monks bound to God and gold alike. Unlocks the Templar Order unit type, recruited on piety and the holy class's own Relics — but permanently fed on Spices, GUILD's prestige good. Requires a Reliquary.

name: Noble House
description: Way of sword and fire. Locks you into the noble path.

name: Noble Knights
description: Most noble of all. Unlocks the Noble Knight unit type.

name: Better Training
description: Train your soldiers in advanced swordsmanship, increasing attack power by a further 10%.

name: Noble Castle
description: The finest stone and the finest masons. Unlocks the Castle building, upgraded from a Fort.

name: Horse Breeding
description: Noble stables breed warhorses on grain fodder. Unlocks the Stud Farm building, which turns Grain into Warhorses — the noble class's unique prestige good.

name: Chivalric Code
description: A code of honor stiffens the resolve of noble householders and their retainers in defense, granting a further 10% defense power.

name: Levy Reform
description: Reformed feudal levies let noble estates muster troops faster, granting 20 extra troops into the draft pool from every Barracks and Capital each turn.

name: Grand Host
description: The full might of noble cavalry, mustered as one grand host. Unlocks the Grand Host unit type, recruited on the noble class's own Warhorses — but permanently fed on Relics, HOLY's prestige good. Requires a Stud Farm.
